why: Two trees ship the product's knowledge and are rewritten before they leave the
build machine: the bundled server (the agent's instruction, the short-script
shape, the guide, the plans — `desktop/app/server/dist/**`) and the phone app's
page inside the APK (which compiles the shared agent core straight from
server/src). `markers` are phrases that MUST exist in the source file they name
and MUST NOT exist anywhere in a shipped tree; both build paths and every run of
`desktop/protect.mjs` fail when either side drifts, and the Android workflow greps
the signed APK itself.
Two trees are deliberately NOT rewritten, and the first attempt to protect them
is why: the desktop UI bundle and the Electron shell (main.js/preload.cjs glue).
Neither contains a single marker — no instruction, no script shape, no guide;
they are minified UI code and plumbing. Obfuscating them bought nothing and cost
a run: the packaged-app end-to-end test timed out at the Command Center's mic
(a step whose failure gives no diagnostics — the app runs, the log is empty), and
the build that shipped them read exactly like the one before. The rule this
leaves behind: rewrite a tree only when it holds something worth hiding *and*
CI drives it end to end.
It is not, and cannot be, "impossible to steal": anyone with the installer on
their own machine can run the code, dump decoded strings from memory, or
reimplement what they see. This pass removes the cheap wins (a readable copy of
everything the app knows, source maps, TypeScript types) and moves the rest into
the trees that are covered by tests. docs/PROTECTING_THE_CODE.md.
Option presets below are passed to javascript-obfuscator verbatim — keep them to
real option names only (the engine rejects anything it does not know).

markers.label: the agent's system instruction (PC and phone)
markers.phrase: You are Soundwave, the AI assistant inside the Soundwave AI app on the user's PC.

markers.label: the phone-alone instruction
markers.phrase: Right now the user's PC is off or out of reach, so you are answering from the Soundwave phone app on your own.

markers.label: the short-script shape's own words
markers.phrase: Every line is long. Add two short punch lines (under eight words) to break the rhythm

markers.label: the guide's alarms section
markers.phrase: The agent can set an alarm on your Android phone.
